messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 10):
"""
This name should not be altered / modified in any form after launching in the market. This name shall appear in all returns etc. which would be submitted to IRDAI. Insurers are advised to indicate in the brand name the type of product offered, such as Micro, CSC etc. as per extant regulations / guidelines] 1.6 Whether New or Modification New / Modification of existing product 1.7 Date of approval by PMC (applicable to General and Health Insurers) 1.8 Specify the Sections which are being modified 1.8.1 Unique ID no. (where application is for modification of an existing product) 1.8.2 Within how many days the Insurer intends to launch the modified version of the product after allotment of UIN 1.8.3 Type of Modification 1. Pricing with change in Benefit Structure
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What must insurers do regarding the brand name of a health insurance product after it is launched in the market?","answer":"Insurers must not alter or modify the brand name in any form after launch, and the name must appear in all returns submitted to IRDAI.","facts":["This name should not be altered / modified in any form after launching in the market.","This name shall appear in all returns etc. which would be submitted to IRDAI."]},{"question":"If an insurer wants to modify an existing health insurance product, what information must they provide regarding the modification?","answer":"They must specify the sections being modified, provide the unique ID number, state how many days they intend to launch the modified version after allotment of UIN, and indicate the type of modification, including pricing changes with benefit structure changes.","facts":["Specify the Sections which are being modified","Unique ID no.
